questions: Where are streaming responses implemented, and which public API methods route into the streaming implementation?

turns.question: Where are streaming responses implemented, and which public API methods route into the streaming implementation?
turns.agentText:
I have enough to give a complete, evidence-backed answer.

## Where streaming is implemented

**Core transport layer** — `src/core/streaming.ts` (class `Stream<Item>`)
- `Stream.fromSSEResponse()` — parses a `fetch` `Response` as Server-Sent Events (via internal `_iterSSEMessages`/`SSEDecoder`/`LineDecoder`) and exposes it as an `AsyncIterable`.
- `Stream.fromReadableStream()` — same, but from a newline-delimited JSON `ReadableStream` (used for re-hydrating a stream on the frontend that was proxied from a backend via `.toReadableStream()`).
- `Stream` also implements `tee()` and `toReadableStream()`.
- `src/streaming.ts` is just a deprecated re-export shim (`export * from './core/streaming'`).

**Wiring from HTTP response → `Stream`** — `src/internal/parse.ts`, function `defaultParseResponse()`: checks `props.options.stream`, and if set, calls either `props.options.__streamClass.fromSSEResponse(...)` (a per-request override) or the default `Stream.fromSSEResponse(...)`. This is the single chokepoint where a raw HTTP response becomes a `Stream` object — every resource method's `stream: true` request option flows through here.

**Higher-level ergonomic stream helpers** (in `src/lib/`), which wrap the raw `Stream<Item>` in stateful accumulators that emit typed events and reconstruct a final object:
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts` — `ChatCompletionStream`, static `createChatCompletion()`; accumulates `ChatCompletionChunk`s into a `ChatCompletionSnapshot`, emits `content`, `content.delta`, `tool_calls.function.arguments.delta`, etc.
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts` + `src/lib/AbstractChatCompletionRunner.ts` — streaming variant of the tool-calling runner loop.
- `src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts` — `ResponseStream`, static `createResponse()`; accumulates Responses API SSE events via `src/lib/responses/ResponseAccumulator.ts`, emits typed events like `response.output_text.delta`.
- `src/lib/AssistantStream.ts` — `AssistantStream` (legacy Assistants/Threads API), with static constructors `createAssistantStream`, `createThreadAssistantStream`, `createToolAssistantStream`.
- `src/lib/EventStream.ts` / `src/lib/EventEmitter.ts` — shared event-emitter base classes these use.

## Public API methods that route into it

| Method | File | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `client.chat.completions.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/chat/completions/completions.ts` | passes `stream: body.stream ?? false` to `this._client.post`, returns `APIPromise<Stream<ChatCompletionChunk>>` |
| `client.chat.completions.stream(params)` | same file | calls `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion(this._client, body, options)` |
| `client.chat.completions.runTools(params)` (when `body.stream`) | same file | delegates to `ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.runTools(...)` |
| `client.responses.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/responses/responses.ts` | same `stream:` flag pattern, returns `APIPromise<Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>>` |
| `client.responses.retrieve(id, {stream:true})` | same file | same pattern, for resuming/polling a response's stream |
| `client.responses.stream(params)` | same file | calls `ResponseStream.createResponse(this._client, body, options)`, which internally calls `client.responses.create`/`retrieve` with `stream: true` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.create(threadId, {stream:true})` | `src/resources/beta/threads/runs/runs.ts` | `stream: params.stream ?? false` + `__synthesizeEventData: true`, returns `Stream<AssistantStreamEvent>` (deprecated, Assistants API) |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.stream(...)` / `.createAndStream(...)` (deprecated alias) | same file | `AssistantStream.createAssistantStream(...)` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputs({stream:true})` / `.submitToolOutputsStream(...)` | same file | `AssistantStream.createToolAssistantStream(...)` |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRun({stream:true})` / `.createAndRunStream(...)` | `src/resources/beta/threads/threads.ts` | `AssistantStream.createThreadAssistantStream(...)` |

All of these ultimately set the request option `stream: true`, which `src/internal/parse.ts:defaultParseResponse` intercepts to build a `Stream` via `src/core/streaming.ts`.

## Not verified
- `src/resources/images.ts` defines streaming *event types* (`ImageGenStreamEvent`, `ImageEditStreamEvent`) and `ImageEditParamsStreaming`/`ImageGenerateParamsStreaming`, implying `images.generate`/`images.edit` also support `stream: true` — I did not read the `Images` class body (lines 14–100) to confirm the exact method signatures.
- `src/realtime/` and `src/resources/realtime.ts` (WebSocket-based) were not examined — Realtime API streaming likely uses a different transport (`internal/ws-adapter*.ts`) rather than SSE `Stream`, but I didn't confirm this.
- Did not inspect `src/lib/AssistantStream.ts` internals in detail (only its public static constructors, referenced from callers).
